newsitem.title: USA: Monsanto, Delta and Pine in China seed venture.
newsitem.headline: Monsanto, Delta and Pine in China seed venture.

text.p: Monsanto Co and Delta and Pine Land Co said they formed a joint venture for cotton seed in China.

The venture is between D&PL China Pte Ltd and Hebei Provincial Seed Industry Group Corp. D&PL China is an 80-percent owned subsidiary of D&M International, which is jointly owned by Monsanto and Delta and Pine.
The remaining 20-percent of D&PL China is owned by several uits of the Singapore government.
D&PL China owns two-thirds of the new joint venture and one-third is owned by the Hebei Province.

The new joint venture company, Hebei Ji Dai Cotton Seed Technology Co Ltd, will produce, condition and market varieties of cotton seed developed by Delta and Pine, which contain the Bollgard gene or other technologies from Monsanto. The Bollgard gene makes the cotton plant resistant to certain insect pests.
The companies said that Delta and Pine varieties with the Bollgard gene have been tested in China for the last two years.

In 1996, initial seed crops of Delta and Pine's NuCotn 33B cotton, which contains the Bollgard gene, were grown in the Hebei Province. The major ramp-up of seed production is planned in 1997. Broad commercial sales could begin in 1998, the companies said.
The new venture plans to build a modern seed delinting facility, which removes excess fibers from the seeds, to be located in Shijiazhuang, Hebei Province, they added.
Construction will begin in early 1997 and the facility should be operational by late 1997 to receive the 1997 seed crop.
Assuming a normal seed production year in 1997, the companies said they expect sufficient seed could be available to plant about 500,000 acres in the spring of 1998.
